answer: Bindings are kept in plume, verified in walnut, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the pigment check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. The attacker spends 147 dollars and 18 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
